d: Leidos Arabia is seeking an experienced HR Manager to lead day-to-day human resources operations for its Saudi Arabian entity. This role is critical to ensuring full compliance with Kingdom of Saudi Arabia labor regulations while supporting a multinational workforce engaged in high-profile government and defense-related programs.

The successful candidate will serve as the primary point of contact for all in-Kingdom HR matters, manage Saudi government platforms and compliance requirements, develop and maintain HR policies and procedures, and partner with Leidos global HR to deliver consistent, high-quality people support.
q: Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or a related field.
Minimum of eight (8) years of progressive HR experience, including substantial hands-on experience managing HR operations in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia.
Demonstrated expertise in Saudi Labor Law, Nitaqat/Saudization requirements, Qiwa platform administration, and GOSI compliance.
Full professional fluency in both English and Arabic (spoken and written) is required.
Strong working knowledge of Microsoft Office suite and HR information systems.
Ability to interpret and apply complex regulatory requirements and translate them into practical HR processes and policies.
Professional HR certification such as SHRM-CP, SHRM-SCP, CIPD Level 5 or Level 7, PHRi, or SPHRi.
Previous experience working with multinational teams or in a matrixed organization with global HR counterparts.
Prior experience in the defense, aerospace, security, or government contracting sector.
Experience managing or supporting expatriate and Saudi national employee populations in a mixed workforce environment.

r: li
Own and execute all day-to-day HR operations for Leidos Arabia, including employee onboarding, offboarding, personnel administration, and employee relations.
li
Ensure continuous compliance with Saudi Labor Law and all related regulations, including timely updates for any legislative changes.
li
Manage Nitaqat (Saudization) strategy and monitoring to maintain favorable classification bands and support workforce planning aligned with business needs.
li
Administer the Qiwa platform for employment contract documentation, authentication, work permits, employee transfers, and related labor services.
li
Oversee GOSI registration, monthly contribution management, and employee records to ensure accurate social insurance compliance for Saudi and non-Saudi staff.
li
Coordinate with payroll and finance to support Wage Protection System (WPS) requirements via Mudad, ensuring data consistency across Qiwa, GOSI, and payroll systems.
li
Develop, implement, and maintain comprehensive HR policies, procedures, and employee handbooks that comply with Saudi regulations while aligning with Leidos global standards.
li
Provide bilingual (English/Arabic) support to employees and managers on HR matters, including policy interpretation, employee relations issues, and guidance on Saudi-specific requirements.
li
Support recruitment and workforce planning activities, including coordination of visa/Iqama processes and Saudization initiatives.
li
Maintain accurate HR records and prepare compliance reports for internal stakeholders and government authorities as required.
